statements.t: Based on our strong year-to-date performance, we have raised our full-year guidance for all major financial metrics.
We now anticipate sales growth of 8% to 10%, along with improved profitability across all three segments, as our Pivot to Growth Strategy continues to build momentum."

We are on track to deliver near-record share repurchases in 2026 and continue to drive internal investments to support our future growth, which underscores our confidence in the business and our commitment to delivering consistent and superior results for our shareholders."

• During the third quarter, the Company repurchased approximately 538,000 shares of its common stock for approximately $352 million and remains on track to repurchase a total of $460 million in shares in 2026, in-line with last year's record $466 million buyback program;
Entering 2027, the Company expects to have remaining open repurchase authorization of $600 million; and
The Company is updating its full-year 2026 Adjusted financial guidance (1) as follows:

(1) Reconciliations of Reported to Adjusted 2025 operating results and 2026 financial guidance are available in the Appendix, and exclude first-year purchase accounting costs associated with prior-year acquisitions, costs associated with both our FY24 and FY26 Restructuring Programs, and gains/losses associated with recording equity securities held for investment purposes at fair value.

A more detailed breakdown of the Company’s 2026 financial guidance by segment and by market, as well as all reconciliations of Reported GAAP amounts to Adjusted non-GAAP amounts, can be found in the accompanying schedules.
The Company will host a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results and updates to 2026 guidance at 10:00 a.m.

A live webcast of the call and the accompanying financial presentation, as well as a webcast replay of the call, will be made available on the internet by visiting the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at www.curtisswright.com .
